jobs.description:
Who We Are
DB Global Technology, Deutsche Bank's technology center in Central and Eastern Europe, opened its Bucharest office in January 2014 and is continuously expanding. The team comprises enthusiastic professionals working in an international environment, dedicated to learning new technologies and fundamentally changing how Deutsche Bank operates.
We're looking for a talented and motivated Backend Engineer with Spring Security hands on experience.
What You’ll Be Doing
Work together with our highly skilled international development teams to build and maintain features of our Applications and Systems
Ensure proper performance and quality of the written code and continuously participate in code reviews
Write unit tests for robustness, edge cases and general reliability
Write code in compliance with our coding standards and security mechanisms
Continuously collaborate with cross-functional teams, product owners, designers and QA team in an agile environment
Participate in developer guilds and enjoy learning/sharing knowledge with the team
Take on the role of a technical forward thinker and take part in the support and training of junior developer
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in enterprise software development
Extensive Java and Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Spring Cloud, ...) experience
Spring Security hands on experience
Deep JPA & Hibernate expertise with strong SQL knowledge
Proven hands-on experience with GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, etc.)
Experience with building and consuming RESTful APIs
Solid understanding of software design patterns and architectural principles

jobs.description:
Your mission:
Develop backend services for the SCADA system
Implement data acquisition and data processing solutions
Develop secure update and device management mechanisms
Ensure scalability, performance and reliability
Design and implement APIs and communication services
Collaborate closely with Frontend, DevOps and Test engineers
Develop and maintain automated backend tests
Contribute to the overall architecture and technical decisions
Your profile:
3+ years in software development
Strong software development skills (Rust/Kotlin)
Backend development (MQTT, REST API, IPC)
Industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, IEC 60870/61850, Modbus)
Time-series data processing
Linux and container technologies
Software architecture and design principles
Experience in agile software development
Hands-on in industrial cybersecurity
Good communication skills
Bonus: Experience with SCADA or comparable industrial systems
What We Offer You
Working for a better future: with us, you'll create a better future for us and all the generations after us
Flexibility: With our home office and working time model
Team events: Be part of a team not just at work, our summer and Christmas parties await
A wide range of benefits to make your employee experience worthwhile: Meal vouchers, medical insurance, and much more.
Your Contact Person
Andreea Giurgi
Senior Business Partner People & Culture
Email: a.giurgi@meteocontrol.com
About Us
At meteocontrol, we have been dedicated to renewable energies since 1998 and are one of the world's leading developers of independent energy management systems. With our holistic solutions, we accompany the entire life cycle of energy systems. From planning to commissioning, we support our customers as independent technical consultants. For this we need a team of highly qualified and motivated employees.
Do you want to become part of our diverse team from different departments and drive the future of renewable energies together?
With energy into the future. We are looking forward to you!

Communauté d’experts : faites partie d’une communauté d’experts en ingénierie logicielle et développez votre réseau auprès de clients et dirigeants.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer - Java & Angular
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We’re looking for a talented Full‑Stack Developer with strong expertise in Java and Angular to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you’ll build scalable, high‑quality applications across the entire stack—designing robust backend services in Java while crafting intuitive, responsive user interfaces with Angular. If you enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating in an agile environment, and delivering clean, maintainable code, this opportunity is a great fit.
What You’ll Be Doing
Develop and maintain backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIsBuild responsive, user‑friendly frontend applications using Angular
Collaborate with product owners, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions
Write clean, maintainable, and well‑tested code across the full stack
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices
Integrate third‑party services, APIs, and internal systems
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across frontend and backend components
Contribute to architectural decisions and propose technical enhancements
Work within an agile environment, participating in sprint planning, stand‑ups, and retrospectives
What you’ll bring along
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Minimum 5–7 years of professional software development experience
Strong hands‑on experience with Java 17 or Java 21, including modern language features
Solid expertise in Spring Boot, including experience with migrations and commonly used Spring starters/frameworks
Proficiency in building responsive, modular front‑end applications using Angular
Good understanding of SQL and relational database concepts
Familiarity with testing methodologies, including unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing
Experience working with Azure cloud services and Git for version control
Ability to design, develop, and maintain full‑stack solutions in an agile environment
Strong problem‑solving skills and a focus on writing clean, maintainable code

jobs.title: Full-stack Technical Lead (Java+React)
jobs.description:
N-iX is a global software development service company that helps businesses across the globe create next-generation software products. Founded in 2002, we unite 2,400+ tech-savvy professionals across 40+ countries, working on impactful projects for industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries. Join N-iX and become part of a team where your ideas make a real impact.
Nowadays, finding a long-term job with an interesting project can feel like a real challenge.
But hey — if you're an experienced
Technical Lead / Full Stack Engineer (Java + React)
, look no further!
Yes, it's real. You're not dreaming. Miracles do exist!
When it comes to our customer – a strategic partner of ours in the integrated Shipping Services. They have set themselves apart as an independent carrier with a fresh, unique approach. Their strategy as a global niche carrier offers distinctive advantages to customers worldwide. We have created a smart, efficient network that ensures stable, reliable services; and we have made it our mission to focus on the needs of our customers, which stand at the heart of all our decisions. The main idea of our product operates in select trades, where it has a competitive advantage and where it can provide superior service. We maintain a flexible partnership approach with other major carriers, and our new line structure is a much-needed alternative to customers concerned about the current alliance-dominated market.
Responsibilities:
Guide, mentor, and foster the growth of full-stack engineers within the team, championing engineering excellence and XP practices.
Lead the architectural design and technical direction of innovative full-stack applications, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with business goals.
Establish and champion high standards of code quality, testing (TDD/BDD), CI/CD pipelines, and robust DevOps practices.
Act as a key technical point of contact, collaborating closely with product owners and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into actionable technical strategies.
Direct full-stack development of innovative applications, remaining actively involved in writing code and remote pairing.
Own the entire development cycle, including design, architecture, development, testing, and DevOps deployment.
Foster a highly collaborative Extreme Programming (XP) environment featuring remote pairing and rapid feedback loops.
Requirements:
BS degree
in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience
in technical leadership is a must.
6+ years
of full-stack development experience.
6+ years
of experience in the following technologies: Java, Spring.
Proven experience with Functional Programming and Java Streams.
2+ years
of experience in front-end development with React.
Experience with developing a reactive UI (Reactive JS).
2+ years
of experience in TDD/BDD development in the following frameworks: JUnit, Jasmine, Mockito, Protractor/Selenium.
2+ years
of experience in microservices-based architecture and tools (Spring Boot/Cloud).
AI experience
Experience in DevOps development and Jenkins (must).
Experience in development in Kotlin – an advantage.
Experience in designing, developing, and deploying cloud/hybrid-based solutions.
Experience in developing and deploying in Container-based environments (Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry).
Deep familiarity with the following design concepts: microservices, service discovery, circuit breakers.
Strong leadership abilities
with the capacity to appropriately prioritize, plan, and delegate complex work in a rapidly changing environment.
Versatility and capability to switch easily between different tasks and technologies.
Experience in assessing a broad range of information solutions and products.
Strong critical thinker with an exceptional problem-solving aptitude.
Excellent English
skills - both verbal and written.
We offer*:
Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
A competitive salary and good compensation package
Personalized career growth
Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
Education reimbursement
Memorable anniversary presents
Corporate events and team buildings
Other location-specific benefits
not applicable for freelancers
